theme.label: Theme
theme.toggle: Switch between light and dark theme

palette.title: Commands
palette.description: Navigate and create without leaving the keyboard.

auth.loginSubtitle: Your GitHub account is the key — it also brings in your repositories later.
auth.inviteOnly: Sign-up is invite-only. Without a valid code, no account is created.

errors.oauth_failed: Could not reach GitHub right now. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.sem_codigo: GitHub did not return an authorization code. Start the sign-in again.
errors.falha_no_login: The session was not created. Start the sign-in again.

invite.title: Accept invite
invite.subtitle: We still need your invite code and the name that goes in your public address.
invite.usernameHint: 3 to 30 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore. It becomes /u/your-name.

errors.not_authenticated: Your session expired. Sign in with GitHub again.
errors.already_has_profile: This account already has a profile.
errors.code_not_found: No invite matches that code. Check whether you copied all of it.
errors.code_expired: This invite expired. Ask whoever invited you for a new code.
errors.code_already_used: This invite was already used. Each code works once.
errors.username_too_short: The name needs at least 3 characters.
errors.username_invalid_chars: Use only lowercase letters, numbers, hyphen and underscore — no spaces or accents.
errors.username_taken: That name belongs to someone else. Pick another.
errors.unknown: Something broke while creating the account. Try again.
